rows: \(\lambda\): spatial repetition / m. \(T\): time repetition / s. \(f=1/T\) / Hz. Propagation speed \(v_{\mathrm w}=f\lambda\).
\(k=2\pi/\lambda\) / rad m⁻¹; \(\omega=2\pi f\) / rad s⁻¹. \(kx\), \(\omega t\), \(\phi\): rad.
\(y=A\cos(kx-\omega t+\phi)\): rightward for \(k,\omega>0\). Plus time term: leftward. Speed \(\omega/k\); local material motion differs.
\(y=y_1+y_2\), at the same position/time and common zero. Small disturbances in a linear model; add signed deviations.
Same direction, frequency, wavelength, amplitude: \(y=2A\cos(\delta/2)\cos(\theta+\delta/2)\), \(\theta=kx-\omega t\). Amplitude \(2A|\cos(\delta/2)|\).
In-phase sources, common wavelength: \(\Delta r=m\lambda\) reinforces; \(\Delta r=(m+\tfrac12)\lambda\) opposes. Equal arriving amplitudes needed for zero. Integer \(m\).
\(A\sin(kx-\omega t)+A\sin(kx+\omega t)=2A\sin(kx)\cos(\omega t)\). Equal opposite components; local amplitude \(2A|\sin(kx)|\).
For that sine form: nodes \(x=n\lambda/2\); antinodes \(x=(2n+1)\lambda/4\), integer \(n\). A node is zero at all times.
\(\lambda_n=2L/n\); \(f_n=nv_{\mathrm w}/(2L)\), \(n=1,2,\ldots\). Uniform string, common speed, fixed ends; \(n\) lobes, \(n-1\) interior nodes.
Transverse string displacement: fixed end inverts; ideal free end does not. Stationary linear boundary, steady source: frequency unchanged; \(\lambda_2=v_2/f\).
Opening width \(a\): compare \(a/\lambda\). Large ratio: narrower main spread; comparable/smaller ratio: broader spread. Spread and transmitted power differ.

import numpy as np
x = np.linspace(0, 2, 401)       # metres
A, lam, f, t = 0.003, 2.0, 1.0, 0.0
k, omega = 2*np.pi/lam, 2*np.pi*f
phase = k*x - omega*t
y1 = A*np.cos(phase)
y2 = A*np.cos(phase + np.pi)
y = y1 + y2
assert np.allclose(y, 0, rtol=0, atol=1e-12)
# Standing product: equal sine components
standing = 2*A*np.sin(k*x)*np.cos(omega*t)
